items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: I had a woman called Emma Davis that I could, when I was at Hunts, uh, at Hunts and Nagel, so, that woman was crazy about me.

ctx.x: And Tony Jackson said, oh, I'm gonna buy you a pearl gray suit.

Oh, boy, that woman used to be good that time. You had, if you had a woman up there hustling, she was good. Uh-huh. She cared for you. She's gonna, she's gonna hustle and give you anything you want. Uh-huh. Yeah. I had a woman called Emma Davis that I could, when I was at Hunts, uh, at Hunts and Nagel, so, that woman was crazy about me. And she'd give me anything.
